statements.statement: The patient presents with persistent palpitations
The patient has a known history of atherosclerotic heart disease of the native coronary artery
The symptoms are intermittent in nature
Long-term continuous ECG monitoring (CPT 93247) was billed
The diagnosis codes are I25.10 and R00.2
The service was denied under reason code PR-204
The denial reason is that the service is not covered under the member's current benefit plan
